translations.web: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.
translations.bsb: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: We have a strong city; salvation is established as its walls and ramparts.
translations.kjv: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will God appoint for walls and bulwarks.
